# ---- §8 inputs: every value labelled; D1-D5 of the fix list (23 Nov 2026) applied
YEARS_F4 = list(range(2026, 2036))
FLEET = BASELINE_2025["fleet_total"]                       # D1: 2,210 register baseline (2,239 kept as a sensitivity in notebook 04)
ZE25 = BASELINE_2025["n_bev"] + BASELINE_2025["n_h2"]
BUS_LIFE = assume("Bus service life (years), all technologies (D2)", 13, "P",
                  "EMT cut its bus amortisation period from 15 to 13 years (diario.madrid.es/?p=17529, via notebook 04)",
                  "retirements in both scenarios", "12 (financial model) and 15")
CNG_PRICE_EUR = assume("CNG bus purchase price (EUR)", 310_000, "D",
                       "EMT bought 200 gas buses for EUR 62 m in 2022 (diario.madrid.es/?p=72588, via notebook 04); one price for both sizes",
                       "S0 capex (CNG replacements before 2030)")
CHARGER_EUR = assume("Charging infrastructure per point (EUR) (D4)", 110_000, "D",
                     "Sanchinarro award: EUR 12,581,413.59 excl. VAT for 114 inverted pantographs, including the grid connection works and "
                     "canopy (EMT Mar 2026; TED 3953-2026) = EUR 110k per point; one point per battery bus (brief 4.5)",
                     "capex_meur", "EUR 57k (Carabanchel, existing grid) and EUR 203k (new substation)")
POINTS_2025 = assume("Charging points in service at end 2025", 410, "V", "EMT: 410 points (250 pantographs, 160 plugs), see §6", "charger capex")
COMMITTED = assume("Committed depot projects: (EUR m, {year: share})", {
    "Sanchinarro electrification (114 points, 8 MW)": (12.58, {2026: 0.5, 2027: 0.5}),
    "La Elipa new all-electric centre (318 points, 20 MW)": (112.12, {2027: 1 / 3, 2028: 1 / 3, 2029: 1 / 3}),
}, "V", "Sanchinarro: EMT award Mar 2026, EUR 12,581,413.59 excl. VAT, 12 months; La Elipa: award to OHLA-Seranco, EUR 112,119,303 "
        "excl. VAT (tender budget EUR 134.3 m), up to 32 months from signing (https://diario.madrid.es/blog/notas-de-prensa/"
        "emt-madrid-adjudica-la-ejecucion-de-las-obras-del-nuevo-centro-de-operaciones-de-la-elipa/); year split is an assumption (A)",
        "capex_meur, both scenarios")
POINTS_COMMITTED = {2027: 114, 2029: 318}            # points those projects add, from the year they finish
S0_DELIVERIES = assume("S0 adjusted pace: net zero-emission buses added per year (D3)", {2026: 70, 2027: 65}, "V",
                       "2026: EMT 2026 budget, 70 e-buses for EUR 47.7 m; 2027: EMT 2027 draft budget, 65 e-buses for EUR 34.3 m "
                       "(https://www.ecoticias.com/?p=501029). Whether the 65 include the last 50 of the 120-bus order is not published: "
                       "50 kept as a sensitivity. From 2028 no tender is announced, so the unadjusted 2021-25 pace "
                       f"({S0_PACE_UNADJUSTED:.1f}/yr, §3) continues", "File 4 S0", "2027 = 50; unadjusted pace every year")
ZE_ONLY_FROM = assume("Year from which every S0 replacement is zero-emission (D5)", 2030, "V",
                      "Regulation (EU) 2024/1610: 90 % of new city buses zero-emission from 2030, 100 % from 2035 "
                      "(https://climate.ec.europa.eu/eu-action/transport-decarbonisation/road-transport/lorries-buses-and-coaches_en); "
                      "EMT buying only zero-emission from 2030 is the team's reading (A)", "File 4 S0 from 2030", "90 % share 2030-34")
NO_GAS_PURCHASES = assume("No gas bus is bought in either scenario (D8)", True, "A",
                          "Team decision, 24 Nov 2026: no gas-bus order for 2026 or later is evidenced; EMT's 2026 and 2027 budgets buy "
                          "e-buses only", "File 4 S0 2026-2029", "S0 refills with gas until 2029")
def s0_pace(y):
    return S0_DELIVERIES.get(y, round(S0_PACE_UNADJUSTED))

# Service km (brief: 365 equivalent service days) and the standard/articulated mix, from File 2
KM_YEAR = file2.daily_km.sum() * P["service_days"]
ART_KM_SHARE = assume("Articulated share of service km (all technologies, all years)",
                      round(file2.loc[file2.bus_type == "Articulated", "daily_km"].sum() / file2.daily_km.sum(), 4), "D",
                      "File 2: km on articulated lines / total km; applied to BEV, H2 and CNG alike", "energy, CNG, CO2")
def mix(d):
    return (1 - ART_KM_SHARE) * d["Standard"] + ART_KM_SHARE * d["Articulated"]
KWH_KM, CNG_KG_KM = mix(P["kwh_km"]), mix(P["cng_kg_km"])
S25 = ZE25 / FLEET                                   # 2025 zero-emission share of fleet and of km (counterfactual)
H2_SHARE = BASELINE_2025["n_h2"] / FLEET             # hydrogen buses: no new purchases, same share of km as of fleet (A)

# S1 line plan from File 2: share of the non-2025 network converted by each year-end (buses and km)
later = file2[file2.electrification_year > 2025]
conv_bus = {y: later.loc[later.electrification_year <= y, "peak_buses"].sum() / later.peak_buses.sum() for y in [2025] + YEARS_F4}
conv_km = {y: later.loc[later.electrification_year <= y, "daily_km"].sum() / later.daily_km.sum() for y in [2025] + YEARS_F4}

      f"2025 ZE share {S25:.1%}")

Service km 124.6 M/yr | articulated km share 3.7% | kWh/km 1.321 | CNG kg/km 0.457 | 2025 ZE share 20.9%
S0 inputs: unadjusted pace 77.2/yr (2021-25); target 70 (2026), 65 (2027), then 77/yr; no gas bus bought (D8); every replacement zero-emission from 2030 (D5). The additions File 4 actually uses are printed after the File 4 table.

























Fleet model. Each year: buses past their 13-year life retire; the zero-emission target sets how many battery buses are bought (S0: 70, 65, then 77 a year; S1: File 2's line plan, with 2026 equal to the 70 delivered). If retirements do not leave enough room, the oldest gas buses retire early. Neither scenario buys gas (D8): a worn gas bus keeps running until its e-bus arrives (_deferred). From 2030 S0 replaces every retiring bus with an e-bus (D5). Energy, CNG, CO₂ and the 2025-frozen counterfactual follow from the km allocation. Columns starting with _ are diagnostics, not written to File 4.

def simulate_f4(scenario, years=None):
    """Year-by-year fleet, purchases, retirements, energy, CO2 and capex. scenario 0 = S0, 1 = S1.
    years: File 4's 2026-2035 by default; S0 can run longer (printed only, never written)."""
    buses = f25[["fuelType", "size", "age_years"]].rename(columns={"fuelType": "fuel", "age_years": "age"}).reset_index(drop=True)
    buses["fuel"] = buses.fuel.map({"EL": "BEV", "H": "H2", "GN": "CNG"})
    ze_prev, km_share_prev, points_built, rows = ZE25, S25, 0, []
    for y in (years or YEARS_F4):
        buses["age"] += 1
        if scenario == 1:
            ze_target = ZE25 + S1_DELIVERED_2026 if y == 2026 else ZE25 + round((FLEET - ZE25) * conv_bus[y])
        else:
            ze_target = min(FLEET, ze_prev + s0_pace(y))
        eol = buses.age > BUS_LIFE
        removed, buses = buses[eol], buses[~eol]
        ze_now = int(buses.fuel.isin(["BEV", "H2"]).sum())
        need_ze = ze_target - ze_now
        if scenario == 0 and y >= ZE_ONLY_FROM:                     # D5: from 2030 every replacement is zero-emission
            need_ze = min(FLEET - ze_now, max(need_ze, len(removed)))
        deferred = 0
        if (scenario == 1 or NO_GAS_PURCHASES) and need_ze < len(removed):   # D8: no gas bought; worn buses wait for their e-bus
            keep = removed.sort_values("age").index[:len(removed) - need_ze]
            deferred = len(keep)
            buses, removed = pd.concat([buses, removed.loc[keep]]), removed.drop(keep)
        early = max(0, need_ze - len(removed))
        if early:                                                     # retire the oldest CNG buses before their life ends
            cng_idx = buses[buses.fuel == "CNG"].sort_values("age", ascending=False).index[:early]
            removed = pd.concat([removed, buses.loc[cng_idx]])
            buses = buses.drop(cng_idx)
        ze_buy, cng_buy = need_ze, len(removed) - need_ze
        sizes = removed["size"].sort_values().tolist()               # replace like for like: "Articulated" sorts first
        new = pd.DataFrame({"fuel": ["BEV"] * ze_buy + ["CNG"] * cng_buy, "size": sizes, "age": 0.0})
        buses = pd.concat([buses, new], ignore_index=True)
        price = new.apply(lambda b: P["bus_price_eur"][b["size"]] if b.fuel == "BEV" else CNG_PRICE_EUR, axis=1).sum()
        n_bev, n_h2, n_cng = (buses.fuel == "BEV").sum(), (buses.fuel == "H2").sum(), (buses.fuel == "CNG").sum()

        # Service km: S1 follows File 2's line order (km-weighted) on top of the 2025 share; S0 follows fleet shares (brief default)
        km_share_end = min(1.0, max((n_bev + n_h2) / FLEET, S25 + (1 - S25) * conv_km[y])) if scenario == 1 else (n_bev + n_h2) / FLEET
        ze_km = KM_YEAR * (km_share_prev + km_share_end) / 2          # whole-year average of start and end of year
        bev_km, cng_km = ze_km - KM_YEAR * H2_SHARE, KM_YEAR - ze_km
        elec_mwh = bev_km * KWH_KM / P["charge_eff"] / 1000           # grid-input energy
        cng_t = cng_km * CNG_KG_KM / 1000
        co2 = cng_t * P["cng_kgco2_per_kg"] + elec_mwh * P["grid_gco2_kwh"] / 1000
        cf_bev_km, cf_cng_km = KM_YEAR * (S25 - H2_SHARE), KM_YEAR * (1 - S25)        # 2025 shares frozen
        co2_cf = cf_cng_km * CNG_KG_KM / 1000 * P["cng_kgco2_per_kg"] + cf_bev_km * KWH_KM / P["charge_eff"] / 1000 * P["grid_gco2_kwh"] / 1000

        points_avail = POINTS_2025 + sum(v for k, v in POINTS_COMMITTED.items() if k <= y) + points_built
        new_points = max(0, n_bev - points_avail)
        points_built += new_points
        committed = sum(eur * split.get(y, 0) for eur, split in COMMITTED.values())
        capex = price / 1e6 + new_points * CHARGER_EUR / 1e6 + committed
        rows.append(dict(year=y, scenario=scenario, fleet_total=len(buses), n_bev=n_bev, n_h2=n_h2, n_cng=n_cng,
                         ze_share_pct=round(100 * (n_bev + n_h2) / len(buses), 1), electricity_mwh=round(elec_mwh, 1),
                         cng_t=round(cng_t, 1), co2_t=round(co2, 1), co2_avoided_t=round(co2_cf - co2, 1), capex_meur=round(capex, 2),
                         _bought_bev=ze_buy, _bought_cng=cng_buy, _retired_eol=int(eol.sum()) - deferred, _deferred=deferred,
                         _retired_early=early, _new_points=new_points, _ze_km_share=round(ze_km / KM_YEAR, 3),
                         _cng_co2_t=round(cng_t * P["cng_kgco2_per_kg"], 1), _capex_buses=round(price / 1e6, 2),
                         _capex_chargers=round(new_points * CHARGER_EUR / 1e6, 2), _capex_committed=round(committed, 2)))
        ze_prev, km_share_prev = n_bev + n_h2, km_share_end
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

F4_COLS = ["year", "scenario", "fleet_total", "n_bev", "n_h2", "n_cng", "ze_share_pct", "electricity_mwh", "cng_t", "co2_t",
           "co2_avoided_t", "capex_meur"]
traj = pd.concat([simulate_f4(0), simulate_f4(1)], ignore_index=True)
display(traj.set_index(["scenario", "year"])[["n_bev", "n_cng", "ze_share_pct", "_bought_bev", "_bought_cng", "_retired_eol", "_deferred",
                                               "_retired_early", "_new_points", "_ze_km_share", "co2_avoided_t", "capex_meur"]])
summ = traj.groupby("scenario").agg(capex_meur=("capex_meur", "sum"), co2_avoided_kt=("co2_avoided_t", lambda s: s.sum() / 1000),
                                    bev_bought=("_bought_bev", "sum"), cng_bought=("_bought_cng", "sum"), retired_early=("_retired_early", "sum"))
summ["year_100pct"] = traj[traj.ze_share_pct >= 100].groupby("scenario").year.min().reindex(summ.index)
display(summ.round(1))
file4 = traj[F4_COLS]
file4.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "File_4.csv"), index=False, encoding="utf-8")
s1t, s0t = traj[traj.scenario == 1].set_index("year"), traj[traj.scenario == 0].set_index("year")
check("File 4: exactly 20 rows, 2026-2035 x {0, 1}", len(file4) == 20 and set(file4.year) == set(YEARS_F4) and set(file4.scenario) == {0, 1})

      f"S1 {s1t.loc[2026, '_bought_bev']}, S0 {s0t.loc[2026, '_bought_bev']}")
check("D8: no gas bus bought in either scenario", traj._bought_cng.sum() == 0)
_r26 = file4[file4.year == 2026].drop(columns="scenario")

# B1: the S0 pace File 4 actually uses = net zero-emission buses added per year
s0_added = (s0t.n_bev + s0t.n_h2).diff().fillna(s0t.n_bev.iloc[0] + s0t.n_h2.iloc[0] - ZE25).astype(int)
print(f"S0 pace used in File 4 (net zero-emission buses added per year, {YEARS_F4[0]}-{YEARS_F4[-1]}): {s0_added.tolist()}")
_f4 = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "File_4.csv")).query("scenario == 0").set_index("year")

# Earliest credible year (B2, D6). Supplementary run to 2040; writes nothing to File 4.
PURCHASE_CAPS = assume("E-buses EMT can buy per year from 2028 (swept)", [165, 200, 273, 340], "A",
                       "165: about EMT's recent pace (e-bus peak 116 in 2024; all-bus peak 382 in 2018); 273 and 340: what the financial model's 2033 path needs "
                       "without and with renewals (notebook 04 §10)", "earliest credible year")
EMT_INVEST_BUDGET = assume("EMT total investment budget (EUR m)", {2026: 135.3, 2027: 167.2}, "V",
                           "EMT 2026 budget and 2027 draft budget (notes/financial-model.md; Ecoticias, Nov 2026)", "cross-check on bus capex")
DEPOT_PROJECTS = assume("Depot charging positions and finish year", {
    "Carabanchel +27": (27, 2026, "committed"), "Sanchinarro +114": (114, 2027, "committed"), "La Elipa +318": (318, 2029, "committed"),
    "Entrevías +465": (465, 2028, "team proposal"), "Las Tablas +650 (replaces Fuencarral)": (650, 2031, "team proposal; City plan about 650, EMT award 620")}, "A",
    "notes/financial-model.md section 3.1; Carabanchel, Sanchinarro and La Elipa are awarded (V), the rest are the team's proposal (A); "
    "a balancing retrofit at Carabanchel and Sanchinarro finishing 2030 covers the remaining buses; budgeted 2026-27 deliveries "
    "arrive whatever the charger count (EMT plans their charging)", "charging capacity by year")
DELAY_CASES = {"on time": {}, "Entrevías +1": {"Entrevías +465": 1}, "Las Tablas +2": {"Las Tablas +650 (replaces Fuencarral)": 2},
               "retrofits +2": {"retrofit": 2}}
AVG_BUS_PRICE = float((f25["size"] == "Standard").mean() * P["bus_price_eur"]["Standard"]
                      + (f25["size"] != "Standard").mean() * P["bus_price_eur"]["Articulated"])
FIRST_YEARS_DELIVERED = {2026: S0_DELIVERIES[2026], 2027: S0_DELIVERIES[2027]}   # budgeted: delivered whatever the cap
CHARGING_2025 = assume("Buses the depot chargers could serve at end 2025", 456, "D",
                       "notes/financial-model.md section 3.2: capacity 483 at end 2026 minus Carabanchel's 27 positions", "charging capacity by year")

def capacity_by_year(delays, horizon=2040):
    cap0 = CHARGING_2025
    proj = {k: (n, end + delays.get(k, 0)) for k, (n, end, _) in DEPOT_PROJECTS.items()}
    rest = (FLEET - BASELINE_2025["n_h2"]) - cap0 - sum(n for n, _ in proj.values())
    proj["retrofit"] = (rest, 2030 + delays.get("retrofit", 0))
    return {y: cap0 + sum(n for n, end in proj.values() if end <= y) for y in range(2026, horizon + 1)}

def fleet_100_year(purchase_cap, delays=None, horizon=2040):
    """First year the fleet is 100 % zero-emission when e-bus purchases are capped and a bus needs a charging position.
    No gas bus is bought: a worn gas bus keeps running until an e-bus can replace it. Returns (summary, yearly table)."""
    cap = capacity_by_year(delays or {}, horizon)
    b = f25[["fuelType", "size", "age_years"]].rename(columns={"fuelType": "fuel", "age_years": "age"}).reset_index(drop=True)
    b["fuel"] = b.fuel.map({"EL": "BEV", "H": "H2", "GN": "CNG"})
    rows, early_n, writeoff = [], 0, 0.0
    for y in range(2026, horizon + 1):
        b["age"] += 1
        bev_eol = b[(b.fuel == "BEV") & (b.age > BUS_LIFE)].index
        b = b.drop(bev_eol)                                          # e-bus renewals come first
        n_bev = int((b.fuel == "BEV").sum())
        limit_deliv = FIRST_YEARS_DELIVERED.get(y, purchase_cap)
        room = cap[y] - n_bev if y not in FIRST_YEARS_DELIVERED else 10 ** 6   # budgeted deliveries arrive regardless
        cng = b[b.fuel == "CNG"].sort_values("age", ascending=False)
        buy = max(0, min(limit_deliv, room + len(bev_eol), len(bev_eol) + len(cng)))
        grow = max(0, buy - len(bev_eol))                            # buses beyond renewals replace gas buses
        out = cng.index[:grow]
        e = b.loc[out]
        young = e[e.age <= BUS_LIFE]
        early_n += len(young)
        writeoff += float((CNG_PRICE_EUR * (BUS_LIFE - young.age).clip(lower=0) / BUS_LIFE).sum()) / 1e6
        b = b.drop(out)
        b = pd.concat([b, pd.DataFrame({"fuel": ["BEV"] * buy, "size": "Standard", "age": 0.0})], ignore_index=True)
        n_cng = int((b.fuel == "CNG").sum())
        binding = ("none" if n_cng == 0 else "deliveries" if buy == limit_deliv else "chargers" if buy == room + len(bev_eol) else "gas fleet")
        g = b.loc[b.fuel == "CNG", "age"]
        rows.append(dict(year=y, bought=buy, capacity=cap[y], n_bev=int((b.fuel == "BEV").sum()), n_cng=n_cng,
                         bus_capex_meur=round(buy * AVG_BUS_PRICE / 1e6, 1), binding=binding,
                         oldest_gas=float(g.max()) if len(g) else 0.0, gas_over_life=int((g > BUS_LIFE).sum())))
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    done = df.loc[df.n_cng == 0, "year"]
    y100 = int(done.min()) if len(done) else None
    act = df[df.year <= (y100 or horizon)]
    bind = act[act.binding != "none"].binding
    return dict(purchase_cap=purchase_cap, year_100=y100 or f"after {horizon}",
                ebuses_per_year=round(act[act.year >= 2028].bought.mean(), 0), peak_bus_capex_meur=act.bus_capex_meur.max(),
                cng_retired_early=early_n, writeoff_meur=round(writeoff, 1),
                oldest_gas_bus_years=round(act.oldest_gas.max(), 1), gas_buses_over_13y_peak=int(act.gas_over_life.max()),
                binding=bind.value_counts().index[0] if len(bind) else "none"), df

sweep = pd.DataFrame([{**fleet_100_year(c, d)[0], "delays": dn} for dn, d in DELAY_CASES.items() for c in PURCHASE_CAPS])
display(sweep.set_index(["delays", "purchase_cap"]))
print(f"Cross-check: EMT's whole investment budget is EUR {EMT_INVEST_BUDGET[2026]} m (2026) and EUR {EMT_INVEST_BUDGET[2027]} m (2027); "
      f"bus capex alone at 273/yr is about EUR {273 * AVG_BUS_PRICE / 1e6:.0f} m a year")

# B3: S1 needs a charging position for every e-bus; positions from the depot projects above
s1_gap = pd.DataFrame({y: dict(s1_ebuses=int(s1t.loc[y, "n_bev"]), positions=capacity_by_year({})[y],
                               without_position=int(s1t.loc[y, "n_bev"] - capacity_by_year({})[y])) for y in range(2026, 2031)})
print("S1 e-buses against charging positions, 2026-2030:")
display(s1_gap)

# B2: S0 on 13-year renewals beyond File 4's horizon (printed only)
s0_ext = simulate_f4(0, years=range(2026, 2041)).set_index("year")
S0_100_YEAR = int(s0_ext.index[s0_ext.ze_share_pct >= 100].min())
print(f"S0 on 13-year renewals (File 4's rule, run to 2040): 100 % in {S0_100_YEAR}; e-buses bought per year peak at "
      f"{int(s0_ext._bought_bev.max())} ({int(s0_ext._bought_bev.idxmax())}); no gas bus runs past 13 years")

# Three dates (D6), each from a run
cap2030 = capacity_by_year({})[2030]
need2030 = FLEET - BASELINE_2025["n_h2"]
_y100 = {c: fleet_100_year(c)[0]["year_100"] for c in range(165, 501, 5)}
min_cap_2033 = next((c for c, y in _y100.items() if isinstance(y, int) and y <= 2033), None)
expected, alt200 = fleet_100_year(165)[0], fleet_100_year(200)[0]
EARLIEST = pd.DataFrame([
    dict(date=2030, meaning="S1, required by the brief", value=f"Not achievable: {need2030 - cap2030} e-buses would have no charging position in 2030 "
         f"({cap2030} positions for {need2030} buses), and S1 needs about {round((need2030 - BASELINE_2025['n_bev']) / 5)} e-buses a year "

         value=f"200 e-buses a year: 100 % in {alt200['year_100']}; 165 a year: {expected['year_100']}, with gas buses running to "
               f"{expected['oldest_gas_bus_years']:.0f} years. On 13-year renewals (File 4's S0): 100 % in {S0_100_YEAR}, with purchases "
               f"peaking at {int(s0_ext._bought_bev.max())} a year"),
])
with pd.option_context("display.max_colwidth", None):

# What capex_meur leaves out, and two exposures for the report (printed only; File 4 unchanged)
print("capex_meur includes: buses (brief prices; no gas bus is bought, D8), charging points beyond those installed or committed "
      f"(EUR {CHARGER_EUR / 1000:.0f}k each), and the committed Sanchinarro and La Elipa projects.")
print(f"capex_meur leaves out: (1) grid reinforcement at the Critical depots (no sourced price; see §6); (2) terminus chargers for the "
      f"{int((file2.charging_strategy == 'Opportunity').sum())} Opportunity lines (14 termini, 18 points: about EUR 9.5 M at TMB Barcelona's EUR 529k per point, notebook 04 §9.2); "
      f"(3) extra buses or daytime charging for vehicle blocks over range: {OVER_RANGE_BLOCKS} blocks without deadheading, "
      f"{OVER_RANGE_BLOCKS_DH} with deadheading (§5).")

GAS_NCV_GJ_T = assume("Net calorific value of natural gas (GJ/t)", 48.0, "V",
                      "IPCC 2006 Guidelines, Vol. 2, Table 1.2: 48.0 TJ/Gg (as in EU Regulation 601/2012 Annex VI)", "gas-price exposure")
GAS_PRICE_STEP = assume("Gas price move tested (EUR/MWh)", 10, "A", "Round step for the report", "gas-price exposure")
CARBON_PRICE = assume("Carbon price on CNG from 2028 (EUR/t CO2)", {"ETS2 trigger": 45, "higher case": 60}, "A",
                      "ETS2 covers road fuels from January 2028 (European Commission); EUR 45/t (2020 prices) is the price that triggers "
                      "extra allowances; EUR 60/t is a higher case (A)", "carbon-cost exposure")
expo = traj[["scenario", "year", "cng_t", "_cng_co2_t"]].copy()
expo["cng_gwh"] = (expo.cng_t * GAS_NCV_GJ_T / 3600).round(1)
expo["cost_per_10eur_mwh_meur"] = (expo.cng_gwh * 1000 * GAS_PRICE_STEP / 1e6).round(2)
for k, v in CARBON_PRICE.items():
    expo[f"carbon_meur_{v}"] = np.where(expo.year >= 2028, expo._cng_co2_t * v / 1e6, 0.0).round(2)
display(expo.drop(columns="_cng_co2_t").set_index(["scenario", "year"]).T)
print(f"S0 carbon cost 2028-35 at EUR {CARBON_PRICE['ETS2 trigger']}/t: EUR {expo[expo.scenario == 0][f'carbon_meur_45'].sum():.0f} m; "
      f"S1: EUR {expo[expo.scenario == 1]['carbon_meur_45'].sum():.0f} m")
check("Gas exposure: one row per File 4 row", len(expo) == len(file4))

# Parameters notebook 04 reads, so both notebooks run on the same inputs (B6)
NB01_PARAMS = dict(fleet=FLEET, bus_life=BUS_LIFE, charger_eur=CHARGER_EUR, cng_price_eur=CNG_PRICE_EUR,
                   s0_deliveries=S0_DELIVERIES, s1_delivered_2026=S1_DELIVERED_2026, ze_only_from=ZE_ONLY_FROM,
                   committed_meur={k: v[0] for k, v in COMMITTED.items()}, peak_buses=int(file2.peak_buses.sum()),
                   daily_km=round(float(file2.daily_km.sum()), 1),
                   s1_capex_meur={c: round(float(traj.loc[traj.scenario == 1, c].sum()), 1)
                                  for c in ("capex_meur", "_capex_buses", "_capex_chargers", "_capex_committed")},
                   file4_ref={int(s): dict(ze_pct_2030=float(g.loc[g.year == 2030, "ze_share_pct"].iloc[0]),
                                           capex_meur=round(float(g.capex_meur.sum()), 2)) for s, g in file4.groupby("scenario")})
json.dump(NB01_PARAMS, open(os.path.join(DERIVED, "nb01_params.json"), "w"), indent=1)
print("S1 capex 2026-35 (EUR m):", NB01_PARAMS["s1_capex_meur"])

9 · European benchmark (File 1)¶
Loads data_derived/benchmark_gtfs_intermediate.csv from notebook 02: Madrid plus at least three of the brief's six eligible capitals (London, Paris, Berlin, Brussels, Helsinki, Copenhagen), each on its mandatory network perimeter (brief §4.4), with at least one city fully reproducible from GTFS. Adds Madrid's row from File 2 and the 2025 baseline, plus cited fleet, zero-emission target, charging model and national grid factor per city. Madrid target: 2033 (EMT, reaffirmed Apr 2026).




Decision record · File 1 peers (23 Nov 2026)
| City | Line km and lines | Fleet | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Helsinki | GTFS, whole HSL area, Tue 24 Nov 2026 | HSL 2025 (derived total) | Fully reproducible peer |
| Paris | GTFS, lines serving Paris with their full length (Paris and inner ring), Tue 24 Nov 2026 | RATP Dec 2025 (4,700; 1,100 battery) | Brief perimeter is the former RATP network; km inside Paris only (212,138/day) kept as a sensitivity in notebook 02 |
| London | TfL annual km / 365 and route count (no ready GTFS, brief 4.4) | TfL audit 31 Mar 2025 | Largest peer; documented annual estimate, reference_date set to the peers' day (24 Nov 2026) |
| Copenhagen | GTFS, Movia lines serving Copenhagen + Frederiksberg, km inside the box only, Tue 24 Nov 2026 | Movia 2025 (1,126) scaled to the perimeter by its share of Movia bus km (proxy) | Added 26 Nov 2026 once Denmark's grid factor was sourced (Energinet Miljødeklaration 2025) |
| Berlin | GTFS (VBB), every BVG bus line incl. night and rail-replacement lines, Wed 25 Nov 2026 | BVG in Zahlen 2025 (1,532; 277 electric) | Fourth GTFS-computed peer; feed starts 25 Nov, so the peers' Tuesday is outside it; target left empty (fossil-free, not zero-emission) |


Peer reference day: rolling feeds downloaded on 23 Nov 2026 no longer cover Madrid's 17 Nov, so peers use the first regular Tuesday inside every feed (brief 4.4 allows each city its own reference day); Berlin's feed starts on Wed 25 Nov 2026, so Berlin uses that day. Grid factors differ in basis (Finland and Denmark consumption; France, UK, Germany and Spain generation); the table printed with File 1 shows each basis. Km basis also differs: Copenhagen counts only km run inside the Copenhagen + Frederiksberg box, while Paris counts the full length of every line serving Paris, so Paris's km is the broader measure.
























Cited fields per city. The fields File 1 needs that GTFS cannot give: operator, fleet at end 2025, zero-emission fleet, target year, charging model and national grid factor. Each value is labelled with assume() and its source; ze_share_pct and energy_full_bev_mwh_day are computed when File 1 is assembled. Notes and alternatives per city: notes/section-9-helsinki.md.


















In [42]:

BENCH_CITED["London"] = dict(
    operator="TfL London Buses",
    reference_date=assume("London reference date", "2026-11-24", "A", "Annual estimate (TfL 2025/26 km / 365), not a timetable day; "
                          "dated with the peers' reference day so the column holds a valid date", "File 1 London row"),
    n_bus_lines=assume("London bus routes", 666, "D", "TfL buses performance data, 'Bus service usage by route 2025/26': routes "
                       "with operated km (includes night and school routes)", "File 1 London row"),
    daily_bus_km=assume("London daily bus km", round(459.9e6 / 365, 1), "D",
                        "TfL Annual Network Performance Summary 2025/26: 459.9 million vehicle km operated / 365 days", "File 1 London row"),
    fleet_total=assume("London bus fleet, 31 Mar 2025", 8797, "V", "TfL fleet annual audit, 31 Mar 2025: 'fleet size of 8,797 buses'",
                       "File 1 London row", "No 31 Mar 2026 audit published yet"),
    ze_fleet=assume("London zero-emission buses, 31 Mar 2025", 1972, "V",
                    "TfL fleet audit 31 Mar 2025: 1,972 zero-emission buses (1,951 battery, 1 converted, 20 fuel cell)", "File 1 London row",
                    "'over 2,600' in Dec 2025 (Travel in London 2025, rounded)"),
    fleet_data_year=2025,
    ze_target_year=assume("London zero-emission target year", 2034, "V", "TfL Business Plan (Dec 2023): 'TfL buses will be zero emission by 2034'; "
                          "2030 only subject to government funding", "File 1 London row", "2030 if funded"),
    charging_model=assume("London charging model", "Depot", "V", "Depot charging; pantograph opportunity charging is a trial on route 358 only "
                          "(TfL, since Nov 2024)", "File 1 London row", "Mixed"),
    grid_co2_g_kwh=assume("CO2 factor electricity UK 2025", 131.0, "V", "DESNZ GHG conversion factors 2026: 0.13096 kgCO2e/kWh generated "
                          "(data year 2025)", "File 1 London row", "0.14396 consumed basis"),
    source_urls="; ".join([
        "https://content.tfl.gov.uk/fleet-annual-audit-report-31-march-2025.pdf",
        "https://tfl.gov.uk/corporate/publications-and-reports/buses-performance-data",
        "https://board.tfl.gov.uk/documents/s21541/board-20231213-item06c%20App2%20TfL%202024%20Business%20Plan%20Document.pdf",
        "https://tfl.gov.uk/modes/buses/improving-buses",
        "https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6a2940543b15d05a7ce3202e/2026-GHG-conversion-factors-methodology-report.pdf",
    ]),
)
# Copenhagen (Movia lines serving Copenhagen + Frederiksberg). Team decisions, 26 Nov 2026. Lines and km: notebook 02
# (km inside the box only; Paris counts full line length). Context and lessons: §9b.
_cph_g = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DERIVED, "benchmark_gtfs_intermediate.csv")).set_index("city").loc["Copenhagen"]
_cph_km_share = _cph_g.daily_bus_km / _cph_g.operator_daily_bus_km
_cph_fleet = assume("Copenhagen (perimeter) bus fleet, 2025", round(1126 * _cph_km_share), "P",
                    f"Movia fleet 1,126 (annual report 2025) x perimeter share of all Movia bus km on {_cph_g.reference_date} "
                    f"({_cph_g.daily_bus_km:,.0f} / {_cph_g.operator_daily_bus_km:,.0f} km = {_cph_km_share:.1%}; notebook 02, "
                    "same Rejseplanen feed); Movia publishes no fleet for the two municipalities",
                    "File 1 Copenhagen row", "1,126 if the whole Movia region is used")

# Denmark's grid factor: Energinet's Miljødeklaration (location-based, 125 % method) is published per hour and price area,
# not as one national annual figure, so the 2025 average is the hourly Final values weighted by gross consumption.
DK_DECL = fetch("https://api.energidataservice.dk/dataset/DeclarationGridEmission?start=2025-01-01T00:00&end=2026-01-01T00:00&timezone=dk&limit=0",
                "energinet_declaration_grid_emission_2025.json",
                "Energinet Energi Data Service, Declaration Grid Emission (Miljødeklaration per hour, DK1/DK2), 2025")
DK_CONS = fetch("https://api.energidataservice.dk/dataset/ProductionConsumptionSettlement?start=2025-01-01T00:00&end=2026-01-01T00:00&timezone=dk&limit=0&columns=HourUTC,HourDK,PriceArea,GrossConsumptionMWh",
                "energinet_consumption_settlement_2025.json",
                "Energinet Energi Data Service, Production and Consumption Settlement (gross consumption per hour, DK1/DK2), 2025")
_decl = pd.DataFrame(json.load(open(DK_DECL))["records"])
_cons = pd.DataFrame(json.load(open(DK_CONS))["records"])[["HourUTC", "PriceArea", "GrossConsumptionMWh"]]
_decl = _decl[_decl.FuelAllocationMethod == "125%"].merge(_cons, on=["HourUTC", "PriceArea"], how="left")   # UTC: DK time repeats an hour in October
check("Denmark grid factor: 2025 hourly declaration complete, both price areas, consumption for every hour",
      len(_decl) == 2 * 8760 and _decl.GrossConsumptionMWh.notna().all() and set(_decl.PriceArea) == {"DK1", "DK2"},
      f"{len(_decl)} hours x area; {int((_decl.Version == 'Final').sum())} Final")
_w = lambda d: float((d.CO2PerkWh * d.GrossConsumptionMWh).sum() / d.GrossConsumptionMWh.sum())
_dk_area = {a: round(_w(g), 1) for a, g in _decl.groupby("PriceArea")}
_dk_gco2 = round(_w(_decl), 1)
print(f"Energinet Miljødeklaration 2025, consumption-weighted: Denmark {_dk_gco2} g CO2/kWh | " +
      " | ".join(f"{a} {v}" for a, v in _dk_area.items()))

BENCH_CITED["Copenhagen"] = dict(
    operator="Movia (lines serving Copenhagen and Frederiksberg)",
    fleet_total=_cph_fleet,

File 1 assembly. Merges notebook 02's GTFS rows (benchmark_gtfs_intermediate.csv) with BENCH_CITED and Madrid's own row, then writes File_1.csv.


















In [43]:






F1_COLS = ["city", "operator", "reference_date", "n_bus_lines", "daily_bus_km", "fleet_total", "ze_fleet", "ze_share_pct",
           "fleet_data_year", "ze_target_year", "charging_model", "energy_full_bev_mwh_day", "grid_co2_g_kwh", "source_urls"]
GTFS_PEERS = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DERIVED, "benchmark_gtfs_intermediate.csv"))
BENCH_CITED["Madrid"] = dict(
    operator="EMT Madrid", reference_date=REF_DATE, n_bus_lines=len(file2), daily_bus_km=round(float(file2.daily_km.sum()), 1),
    fleet_total=BASELINE_2025["fleet_total"], ze_fleet=BASELINE_2025["n_bev"] + BASELINE_2025["n_h2"], fleet_data_year=2025,
    ze_target_year=assume("Madrid zero-emission target year", 2033, "V",
                          "EMT CEO, Apr 2026: 'que en 2033 toda nuestra flota sea de cero emisiones' (El Espanol); EMT at Global Mobility Call 2024",
                          "File 1 Madrid row"),
    charging_model=assume("Madrid charging model", "Depot", "V", "All 410 charging points are in EMT depots (§6); no on-route chargers in use",
                          "File 1 Madrid row"),
    grid_co2_g_kwh=P["grid_gco2_kwh"],
    source_urls="; ".join(["https://datos.emtmadrid.es", PUBLISHED.set_index("source").at["City of Madrid, Carta de Servicios 2026", "url"],
                            "https://www.elespanol.com/eventos/2026/wake-up-spain/20260416/alfonso-sanchez-emt-toda-flota-cero-emisiones-coste-euros/1003744209190_0.amp.html"]))

rows = []
for city, c in BENCH_CITED.items():
    g = GTFS_PEERS[GTFS_PEERS.city == city]
    r = dict(city=city, **{k: v for k, v in c.items() if k in F1_COLS and k != "city"})
    if len(g):                                            # GTFS-computed peers take line count and km from notebook 02
        r.update(reference_date=g.reference_date.iloc[0], n_bus_lines=int(g.n_bus_lines.iloc[0]), daily_bus_km=float(g.daily_bus_km.iloc[0]))
    rows.append(r)
file1 = pd.DataFrame(rows)
file1["ze_share_pct"] = (100 * file1.ze_fleet / file1.fleet_total).round(1)
file1["energy_full_bev_mwh_day"] = (file1.daily_bus_km * P["benchmark_kwh_km"] / 1000).round(1)
file1["ze_target_year"] = file1.ze_target_year.astype("Int64")
file1 = file1[F1_COLS]
file1.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "File_1.csv"), index=False, encoding="utf-8")
display(file1.drop(columns="source_urls"))
check("File 1: Madrid plus at least three eligible capitals", "Madrid" in set(file1.city) and len(file1) >= 4, ", ".join(file1.city))
check("File 1: at least one peer computed from source GTFS", file1.city.isin(GTFS_PEERS.city).any(), ", ".join(GTFS_PEERS.city))
check("File 1: Madrid fleet matches the File 4 baseline", int(file1.loc[file1.city == "Madrid", "fleet_total"].iloc[0]) == BASELINE_2025["fleet_total"])
check("File 1: Madrid km and lines match File 2", abs(file1.loc[file1.city == "Madrid", "daily_bus_km"].iloc[0] - file2.daily_km.sum()) < 0.1
      and file1.loc[file1.city == "Madrid", "n_bus_lines"].iloc[0] == len(file2))
check("File 1: charging_model in {Depot, Opportunity, Mixed}", file1.charging_model.isin(["Depot", "Opportunity", "Mixed"]).all())
check("File 1: every row has source_urls", file1.source_urls.fillna("").str.contains("http").all())
GRID_BASIS = pd.DataFrame([
    ("Madrid", "Spain", "generation, direct emissions", "Red Electrica 2025"),
    ("Helsinki", "Finland", "consumption, imports included", "Fingrid 2025"),
    ("Paris", "France", "generation", "RTE Bilan electrique 2025"),
    ("London", "United Kingdom", "generation", "DESNZ 2026 factors, data year 2025"),
    ("Berlin", "Germany", "generation, direct emissions (imports not counted)", "Umweltbundesamt 2025 estimate"),
    ("Copenhagen", "Denmark", "consumption, imports included", "Energinet Miljødeklaration 2025 (hourly, consumption-weighted)"),
], columns=["city", "country", "basis", "source"]).merge(file1[["city", "grid_co2_g_kwh"]], on="city", how="left")
display(GRID_BASIS)
check("File 1: every city's grid factor has a stated basis", set(file1.city) <= set(GRID_BASIS.city))
check("File 1: source_urls separated by '; '", not file1.source_urls.str.contains(r"\|").any())
check("File 1: reference_date is a valid date in every row", pd.to_datetime(file1.reference_date, errors="coerce").notna().all())
print(f"Written: File_1.csv ({len(file1)} rows)")

9b · Copenhagen: deep-dive context¶
Copenhagen's File 1 row is built in §9 above (fleet proxy, 2025 zero-emission share, Energinet grid factor). This cell keeps the Movia-wide context for the report's lessons. Note: File 1 counts Copenhagen's km inside the Copenhagen + Frederiksberg box only, while Paris counts full line length.


Movia/Copenhagen is one of the brief’s six eligible benchmark capitals (§4.4); its GTFS-derived n_bus_lines/daily_bus_km are built in notebook 02 (new “## Copenhagen” section). This cell supplies the fields notebook 02 can’t get from GTFS — fleet size, electric share, zero-emission target, charging model — used by §9 for File 1. Source: internal research note (Joss, 16 Nov 2026), citing City of Copenhagen, Movia and EMT/Ayuntamiento de Madrid official sources. Denmark’s grid CO₂ factor comes from Energinet's 2025 Miljødeklaration (§9).


















In [44]:






# ---- Copenhagen cited fields (fleet, target, charging model) -- pairs with notebook 02's GTFS row ----
for url, fname, note in [
    ("https://www.kk.dk/nyheder/nu-sker-det-koebenhavns-buslinjer-overgaar-til-100-procent-el",
     "cph_100pct_electric_kk.html", "City of Copenhagen: 42 City-funded lines 100% electric since 29 Mar 2026"),
    ("https://www.kk.dk/politik/politikker-og-indsatser/trafik-og-fremkommelighed/ren-kollektiv-trafik",
     "cph_ren_kollektiv_trafik_kk.html", "City of Copenhagen: zero-emission share by year, 2022-2026"),
    ("https://www.sustainable-bus.com/electric-bus/copenhagen-movia-full-electrification/",
     "movia_72pct_sustainablebus.html", "Movia regional fleet 72% electric (794/1,126), Apr 2026"),
    ("https://www.kk.dk/sites/default/files/agenda/a3b74b2b-c1d9-4a79-9244-f299da308e45/a7a19018-0ff2-45c9-90c6-ed394f35ad8d-bilag-1_0.pdf",
     "movia_line2a_pantograph_memo.pdf", "Movia memo: line 2A pantograph reliability, winter backup buses (Apr 2026)"),
    ("https://www.kk.dk/sites/default/files/agenda/a3b74b2b-c1d9-4a79-9244-f299da308e45/cf238f98-acc2-4e2b-a609-8f0d6667d606-bilag-2.pdf",
     "movia_annual_report_2025.pdf", "Movia annual report 2025: fleet, costs, subsidy"),
]:
    fetch(url, fname, note=note, manual=True)

cph_fleet = assume("Copenhagen (Movia) fleet size, 2025", 1126, "V",
                    "Movia annual report 2025")
cph_electric_share = assume("Copenhagen (Movia) electric share, Mar 2026", round(794 / 1126, 3), "V",
                             "Sustainable Bus, Apr 2026 (794 of 1,126 buses)")
cph_city_electric_share = assume("Copenhagen City-funded lines electric share, Mar 2026", 1.00, "V",
                                  "City of Copenhagen, 29 Mar 2026 announcement")
cph_bus_km_day_per_bus = assume("Copenhagen (Movia) bus-km/bus/day", 124, "D",
                                 "Benchmark note (Joss, 16 Nov 2026): 2024 service km / 2025 fleet / 365 days")
cph_passengers_year = assume("Copenhagen (Movia) bus passengers, 2025", 159_700_000, "V",
                              "Movia annual report 2025")
cph_zero_emission_target = assume(
    "Copenhagen zero-emission target",
    "City: 100% achieved 29 Mar 2026; Movia regionwide: ~95% (19 of 20 buses) by 2030", "V",
    "City of Copenhagen Ren kollektiv trafik; Movia annual report 2025",
)
cph_charging_model = assume(
    "Copenhagen charging model",
    "Depot overnight charging on all lines except 2A (4 terminal pantographs, unreliable in winter)", "V",
    "Movia memo on line 2A pantograph charging, Apr 2026",
)
# Denmark's grid CO2 factor: Energinet Miljødeklaration 2025, computed and labelled in §9.
cph_grid_gco2_kwh = BENCH_CITED["Copenhagen"]["grid_co2_g_kwh"]

mad_bus_km_day_per_bus = assume("Madrid (EMT) bus-km/bus/day", round(101.9e6 / BASELINE_2025["fleet_total"] / 365), "D",
                                 "101.9M km/yr (Carta de Servicios 2026) / §3 baseline fleet / 365 days")
mad_electric_share = round((BASELINE_2025["n_bev"] + BASELINE_2025["n_h2"]) / BASELINE_2025["fleet_total"], 3)   # §3 baseline (zero-emission)

cph_vs_madrid = pd.DataFrame([
    dict(metric="Fleet size", copenhagen_movia=cph_fleet, madrid_emt=BASELINE_2025["fleet_total"]),
    dict(metric="Electric share", copenhagen_movia=cph_electric_share, madrid_emt=mad_electric_share),
    dict(metric="Bus-km per bus per day", copenhagen_movia=cph_bus_km_day_per_bus, madrid_emt=mad_bus_km_day_per_bus),
    dict(metric="Passengers per year", copenhagen_movia=cph_passengers_year, madrid_emt=512_100_000),
    dict(metric="Zero-emission target", copenhagen_movia=cph_zero_emission_target,
         madrid_emt="~1/3 by 2030, ~100% by 2033 (city's mobility delegate, Mar 2025)"),
    dict(metric="Charging model", copenhagen_movia=cph_charging_model,
         madrid_emt="Depot: plug + inverted pantograph (Carabanchel, Fuencarral, La Elipa, Entrevias, Sanchinarro)"),
])
display(cph_vs_madrid)

check("Copenhagen and Madrid bus-km/bus/day are both well below the 400km tendered e-bus range",
      cph_bus_km_day_per_bus < 400 and mad_bus_km_day_per_bus < 400,
      f"Copenhagen {cph_bus_km_day_per_bus} km vs Madrid {mad_bus_km_day_per_bus} km")
check("Copenhagen electric share matches the cited 794/1,126",
      abs(cph_electric_share - 794 / 1126) < 0.005,
      f"794/1126 = {794 / 1126:.3f}")

print(textwrap.dedent("""
    Lessons transferable to Madrid (sources: data register above):
    1. Tie the switch to the replacement cycle (Madrid: CNG end-of-life, ~10yr, last CNG Aug 2023).
    2. Charge in the depot; avoid on-street/pantograph charging (Copenhagen's only pantograph line is its problem line).
    3. Secure grid connections early (Carabanchel ratio implies ~190 MVA fleet-wide at full electrification).
    4. Smooth the purchase curve (~220 buses/yr needed to 2033; 120 confirmed through mid-2027).
    5. Rethink who carries the capex (Copenhagen: operator-financed via contracts; Madrid: EMT + temporary EU funds).
    6. Keep a backup fleet during the transition (Copenhagen keeps diesel/gas backup for line 2A).
    7. Price the origin of the buses (Copenhagen: mostly Chinese, cheaper; Madrid: European, 10yr battery warranty).
    """))

Lessons transferable to Madrid (sources: data register above):
1. Tie the switch to the replacement cycle (Madrid: CNG end-of-life, ~10yr, last CNG Aug 2023).
2. Charge in the depot; avoid on-street/pantograph charging (Copenhagen's only pantograph line is its problem line).
3. Secure grid connections early (Carabanchel ratio implies ~190 MVA fleet-wide at full electrification).
4. Smooth the purchase curve (~220 buses/yr needed to 2033; 120 confirmed through mid-2027).
5. Rethink who carries the capex (Copenhagen: operator-financed via contracts; Madrid: EMT + temporary EU funds).
6. Keep a backup fleet during the transition (Copenhagen keeps diesel/gas backup for line 2A).
7. Price the origin of the buses (Copenhagen: mostly Chinese, cheaper; Madrid: European, 10yr battery warranty).


























10 · BI visualisation¶
One self-contained HTML (data embedded, opens by double-click): (i) route map by charging strategy, (ii) depot map with readiness colours and Evidenced/Estimated flag, (iii) benchmark, (iv) S0 vs S1. Each view is also displayed here as a static image (brief 5.3).


Design. Colours follow EMT's public website (blue #2C7ABF, sky #128EE1, charcoal #414042, Noto Sans); readiness uses the brief's green / amber / red. Charging strategy uses blue / purple / dashed charcoal so routes never share a colour with depot readiness. A dashed ring marks a depot whose connection is Estimated; a solid ring, Evidenced. The base map is greyed so route colours carry the meaning. Template and builder: notebooks/bi/.


Data rule. The HTML embeds Files 1–4 exactly as read back from outputs/; route geometry (EMT KML, one direction per line, simplified to about 10 m) is the only other input. A file not yet produced shows as pending in its view, never filled with other numbers.

EMT_BUS_PRICE_PAID = assume("Price EMT paid for 12 m e-buses, 2021-22 (EUR)", (540_960, 550_050), "V",

_f25_bev_age = f25.loc[f25.fuelType == "EL", "age_years"]
def _exposure(sc):
    t = traj[traj.scenario == sc].set_index("year")
    n_bat = int((_f25_bev_age < BATTERY_LIFE).sum()) + int(t.loc[[y for y in t.index if y + BATTERY_LIFE <= 2035], "_bought_bev"].sum())
    n_bev = int(t._bought_bev.sum())
    p_std, p_art = P["bus_price_eur"]["Standard"], P["bus_price_eur"]["Articulated"]
    n_std = round((p_art * n_bev - t._capex_buses.sum() * 1e6) / (p_art - p_std))       # exact: no gas bus is bought (D8)
    return dict(n_bat=n_bat, bat=tuple(n_bat * v / 1e6 for v in BATTERY_SET_EUR), n_std=n_std,
                price=tuple(n_std * (v - p_std) / 1e6 for v in EMT_BUS_PRICE_PAID))
_e0, _e1 = _exposure(0), _exposure(1)
_extra = OVER_RANGE_BLOCKS * P["bus_price_eur"]["Standard"] / 1e6
_rng = lambda t, sign="": f"{sign}{min(abs(v) for v in t):,.0f} to {sign}{max(abs(v) for v in t):,.0f}"
BI_EXPOSURES = [
    dict(item="Mid-life battery replacement", label="P", s0=_rng(_e0["bat"], "+"), s1=_rng(_e1["bat"], "+"),
         basis=f"Battery buses reaching {BATTERY_LIFE} years in 2026-35 ({_e0['n_bat']:,} in S0, {_e1['n_bat']:,} in S1) x EUR "
               f"{BATTERY_SET_EUR[0] / 1000:.0f}-{BATTERY_SET_EUR[1] / 1000:.0f}k per set (EBRD 2021, 2020 prices: an upper bound). Buses bought from 2028 "
               "reach that age after 2035."),
    dict(item="Extra buses for over-range blocks", label="A", s0=f"+{_extra:,.0f}", s1=f"+{_extra:,.0f}",
         basis=f"Upper bound: one more standard bus for each of the {OVER_RANGE_BLOCKS} vehicle blocks over range (section 4), at full conversion. "
               "A daytime top-up would avoid most of it. The fleet is held at one new bus per bus retired."),
    dict(item="Terminus chargers, Opportunity lines", label="P", s0=f"+{TERMINUS_CHARGERS_MEUR:,.1f}", s1=f"+{TERMINUS_CHARGERS_MEUR:,.1f}",
         basis="14 termini, 18 points at TMB Barcelona's EUR 529k per point (notebook 04 section 9.2), once those lines convert."),
    dict(item="Grid reinforcement at Critical depots", label="A", s0="not priced", s1="not priced",

    dict(item="Bus prices at what EMT paid in 2021-22", label="V", s0=_rng(_e0["price"], "-"), s1=_rng(_e1["price"], "-"),

]
_reserve = FLEET - int(file2.peak_buses.sum())

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
EMT_BLUE, EMT_SKY, CHARCOAL, GREYLINE = "#2C7ABF", "#128EE1", "#414042", "#c9c9c9"
STRAT = {"Depot": (EMT_BLUE, "-"), "Opportunity": ("#7B4FB5", "-"), "Not_feasible": (CHARCOAL, "--")}
READY = {"Ready": "#2E9E4F", "Upgrade": "#E8A317", "Critical": "#D64541"}
f1v, f2v, f3v, f4v = (BI[n] for n in FILES)
strat_of = dict(zip(f2v.line_id, f2v.charging_strategy))
depot_of = dict(zip(f2v.line_id, f2v.depot_name))
DEPOT_TINT = dict(zip(sorted(f3v.depot_name), ["#9db8d9", "#c9a9d6", "#a8d5b5", "#e6c79c", "#d9a3a3"]))   # five muted tints
STATIC = {}

def draw_routes(ax, colour_by="strategy"):
    for rid, parts in routes.items():
        line = route_to_line.get(rid)
        if colour_by == "strategy":
            col, ls = STRAT.get(strat_of.get(line), (GREYLINE, "-"))
        else:
            col, ls = DEPOT_TINT.get(depot_of.get(line), GREYLINE), "-"
        for p in parts:
            a = np.array(p)
            ax.plot(a[:, 1], a[:, 0], color=col, ls=ls, lw=0.6 if colour_by == "strategy" else 0.5, alpha=0.8)
    ax.set_aspect(1 / np.cos(np.radians(40.42)))
    ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_yticks([])

# (i) Route map by charging strategy
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 7))
draw_routes(ax)
counts = f2v.charging_strategy.value_counts()
ax.legend([Line2D([], [], color=c, ls=l, lw=2) for c, l in STRAT.values()], [f"{k} ({counts.get(k, 0)} lines)" for k in STRAT], loc="upper left", bbox_to_anchor=(1.0, 1.0))
ax.set_title("(i) EMT lines by charging strategy (File 2)", loc="left")
STATIC["view_i_routes_by_charging_strategy.png"] = fig

# (ii) Depot map: readiness colour, solid ring = Evidenced connection, dashed ring = Estimated
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 7))
draw_routes(ax, colour_by="depot")
LABEL_AT = {"Fuencarral": (-95, 12), "Carabanchel": (-100, -6)}      # close pairs: label to the left
for d in f3v.itertuples():
    ax.scatter(d.longitude, d.latitude, s=d.buses_assigned * 0.8, color=READY[d.readiness_status], zorder=3,
               edgecolor=CHARCOAL, linewidth=1.5, linestyle="-" if d.connection_evidence == "Evidenced" else "--")
    ax.annotate(f"{d.depot_name}\n{d.n_lines_assigned} lines · {d.buses_assigned} buses\n{d.peak_mw_managed:.1f} / {d.connection_mw_estimate:.1f} MW",
                (d.longitude, d.latitude),
                xytext=LABEL_AT.get(d.depot_name, (14, 10)), textcoords="offset points", fontsize=8, color=CHARCOAL,
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.2", fc="white", ec="none", alpha=0.85))
ax.legend([Line2D([], [], marker="o", ls="", color=c, markersize=9) for c in READY.values()]
          + [Line2D([], [], color=CHARCOAL, ls="-", lw=1.5), Line2D([], [], color=CHARCOAL, ls="--", lw=1.5)]
          + [Line2D([], [], color=c, lw=3) for c in DEPOT_TINT.values()],
          list(READY) + ["Evidenced (solid ring)", "Estimated (dashed ring)"] + [f"Routes: {d}" for d in DEPOT_TINT],
          loc="upper left", bbox_to_anchor=(1.0, 1.0))
ax.set_title("(ii) Depots: lines and buses assigned, readiness (managed MW / connection MW, File 3)", loc="left")
STATIC["view_ii_depot_readiness.png"] = fig

# (iii) Benchmark: zero-emission share and daily km
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 3.6))
b = f1v.sort_values("ze_share_pct")
axes[0].barh(b.city, b.ze_share_pct, color=[EMT_BLUE if c == "Madrid" else GREYLINE for c in b.city])
for y, v in enumerate(b.ze_share_pct):
    axes[0].text(v + 1, y, f"{v:.0f} %", va="center", fontsize=8)
axes[0].set_title("Zero-emission share of the bus fleet (%)", loc="left")
axes[1].barh(b.city, b.daily_bus_km / 1000, color=[EMT_BLUE if c == "Madrid" else GREYLINE for c in b.city])
axes[1].set_title("Daily bus km (thousand)", loc="left")
fig.suptitle("(iii) European benchmark (File 1)", x=0.01, ha="left")
fig.tight_layout()
STATIC["view_iii_benchmark.png"] = fig

# (iv) S0 vs S1: zero-emission share and CO2
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 3.6))
for sc, col, lab in ((0, CHARCOAL, "S0 · plan-based pace"), (1, EMT_BLUE, "S1 · 100% by 2030")):
    g = f4v[f4v.scenario == sc]
    axes[0].plot(g.year, g.ze_share_pct, color=col, marker="o", ms=3, label=lab)
    axes[1].plot(g.year, g.co2_t / 1000, color=col, marker="o", ms=3, label=lab)
axes[0].set_title("Zero-emission share of the fleet (%)", loc="left")
axes[1].set_title("CO2 (kt per year)", loc="left")
axes[0].set_ylim(0, 105); axes[1].set_ylim(0)          # axes start at zero so the gap between scenarios is not exaggerated
axes[0].legend()
fig.suptitle("(iv) Scenarios 2026-2035 (File 4)", x=0.01, ha="left")
fig.tight_layout()
STATIC["view_iv_scenarios.png"] = fig

for name, fig in STATIC.items():
    fig.savefig(os.path.join(OUT, name), dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
check("Static captures of views (i)-(iv) saved to outputs/", all(os.path.exists(os.path.join(OUT, n)) for n in STATIC), ", ".join(STATIC))

12 · Final compliance cell¶
Reads File_1.csv–File_4.csv back as saved and prints columns, data types, row counts and head(10) for each, plus the Rule 3 cross-file checks and the File 4 identities. Mandatory (brief 5.1); a missing printout risks disqualification.


















In [48]:






# FINAL COMPLIANCE CELL (brief 5.1 and Rule 3). Reads the four CSVs back AS SAVED and prints everything.
F_COLS = {
 "File_1.csv": ["city","operator","reference_date","n_bus_lines","daily_bus_km","fleet_total","ze_fleet","ze_share_pct",
                "fleet_data_year","ze_target_year","charging_model","energy_full_bev_mwh_day","grid_co2_g_kwh","source_urls"],
 "File_2.csv": ["line_id","daily_km","peak_buses","km_per_bus_day","bus_type","energy_kwh_bus_day","charging_strategy",
                "depot_name","priority_rank","electrification_year","co2_avoided_t_year"],
 "File_3.csv": ["depot_name","latitude","longitude","n_lines_assigned","buses_assigned","night_energy_mwh","peak_mw_unmanaged",
                "peak_mw_managed","connection_mw_estimate","connection_evidence","readiness_status","conversion_year"],
 "File_4.csv": ["year","scenario","fleet_total","n_bev","n_h2","n_cng","ze_share_pct","electricity_mwh","cng_t","co2_t",
                "co2_avoided_t","capex_meur"],
}
CHECKS.clear()
F = {}
for name, cols in F_COLS.items():
    path = os.path.join(OUT, name)
    print("=" * 100, f"\n{name}")
    if not check(f"{name} exists", os.path.exists(path)):
        continue
    df = pd.read_csv(path, encoding="utf-8", dtype={"line_id": str})
    F[name] = df
    print(f"rows: {len(df)} | columns: {len(df.columns)}")
    print(df.dtypes.to_string())
    display(df.head(10))
    check(f"{name} has exactly the required columns, in order", list(df.columns) == cols,
          "" if list(df.columns) == cols else f"got {list(df.columns)}")

close = lambda a, b, tol=1e-3: abs(float(a) - float(b)) <= tol * max(1.0, abs(float(b)))
print("=" * 100, "\nCross-file and internal checks")
if {"File_2.csv", "File_3.csv"} <= F.keys():
    f2, f3 = F["File_2.csv"], F["File_3.csv"]
    check("File 2: priority_rank unique 1..N", sorted(f2.priority_rank) == list(range(1, len(f2) + 1)))
    s = f2.sort_values("priority_rank")
    check("File 2: better rank never has a later electrification_year", s.electrification_year.is_monotonic_increasing)
    check("File 2: electrification_year within 2025-2030", f2.electrification_year.between(2025, 2030).all())
    rng = f2.bus_type.map(P["range_km"])
    depot_ok = ((f2.km_per_bus_day <= rng) == (f2.charging_strategy == "Depot")).all()
    check("File 2: Depot if and only if km_per_bus_day <= range (Rule 2)", depot_ok)
    check("File 2: energy = km_per_bus_day x kWh/km", np.allclose(f2.energy_kwh_bus_day, f2.km_per_bus_day * f2.bus_type.map(P["kwh_km"]), rtol=1e-3))
    check("All File 2 depot names appear in File 3", set(f2.depot_name) <= set(f3.depot_name))
    agg = f2.assign(e=f2.peak_buses * f2.energy_kwh_bus_day / 1000).groupby("depot_name").agg(
        n=("line_id", "count"), b=("peak_buses", "sum"), e=("e", "sum"), y=("electrification_year", "max"))
    m = f3.set_index("depot_name").join(agg, how="left")
    m = m[m.n.notna()]
    check("File 3 n_lines_assigned reproducible from File 2", (m.n_lines_assigned == m.n).all())
    check("File 3 buses_assigned = sum of File 2 peak_buses", (m.buses_assigned == m.b).all())
    check("File 3 night_energy_mwh reproducible from File 2", np.allclose(m.night_energy_mwh, m.e, rtol=1e-3))
    check("File 3 conversion_year = max electrification_year", (m.conversion_year == m.y).all())
    check("File 3 peak_mw_unmanaged = buses x 100 kW", np.allclose(f3.peak_mw_unmanaged, f3.buses_assigned * P["charger_kw"] / 1000, rtol=1e-3))
    check("File 3 peak_mw_managed = energy / (7 x 0.90)", np.allclose(f3.peak_mw_managed, f3.night_energy_mwh / (P["window_h"] * P["charge_eff"]), rtol=1e-3))
    rd = np.where(f3.peak_mw_managed <= f3.connection_mw_estimate, "Ready",
                  np.where(f3.peak_mw_managed <= 1.5 * f3.connection_mw_estimate, "Upgrade", "Critical"))
    check("File 3 readiness_status follows Rule 4", (rd == f3.readiness_status).all())
    check("File 3 connection_evidence in {Evidenced, Estimated}", f3.connection_evidence.isin(["Evidenced", "Estimated"]).all())
    check("File 3 depot names are EMT operations centres", set(f3.depot_name) <= {"Carabanchel", "Fuencarral", "La Elipa", "Entrevías", "Sanchinarro", "Las Tablas"})
    check("File 2 bus_type in {Standard, Articulated}", f2.bus_type.isin(["Standard", "Articulated"]).all())
    check("File 2 charging_strategy in {Depot, Opportunity, Not_feasible}", f2.charging_strategy.isin(["Depot", "Opportunity", "Not_feasible"]).all())
    check("File 2 line_id unique", f2.line_id.is_unique)
    if "ref_lines" in globals():
        check("File 2: one row per line active on the reference day", len(f2) == len(ref_lines), f"{len(f2)} rows vs {len(ref_lines)} lines in GTFS")
    co2 = f2.daily_km * P["service_days"] * (f2.bus_type.map(P["cng_kg_km"]) * P["cng_kgco2_per_kg"]
          - f2.bus_type.map(P["kwh_km"]) / P["charge_eff"] * P["grid_gco2_kwh"] / 1000) / 1000
    check("File 2 co2_avoided_t_year reproducible from the fixed factors", np.allclose(f2.co2_avoided_t_year, co2, rtol=1e-3))
if {"File_1.csv", "File_2.csv"} <= F.keys():
    f1, f2 = F["File_1.csv"], F["File_2.csv"]
    mad = f1[f1.city == "Madrid"]
    if check("File 1 has a Madrid row", len(mad) == 1):
        mad = mad.iloc[0]
        check("File 1 has Madrid + >= 3 eligible capitals", len(f1) >= 4 and set(f1.city) - {"Madrid"} <= {"London","Paris","Berlin","Brussels","Helsinki","Copenhagen"})
        check("Madrid daily_bus_km = sum(File 2 daily_km)", close(mad.daily_bus_km, f2.daily_km.sum()))
        check("Madrid n_bus_lines = count(File 2 rows)", int(mad.n_bus_lines) == len(f2))
        check("Madrid reference_date = File 2 reference date", str(mad.reference_date) == REF_DATE, f"{mad.reference_date} vs {REF_DATE}")
        check("Madrid fleet_total = 2025 baseline", int(mad.fleet_total) == BASELINE_2025["fleet_total"])
        check("Madrid ze_fleet = 2025 baseline", int(mad.ze_fleet) == BASELINE_2025["n_bev"] + BASELINE_2025["n_h2"])
    check("File 1 ze_share_pct = ze_fleet / fleet_total x 100", np.allclose(f1.ze_share_pct, (f1.ze_fleet / f1.fleet_total * 100).round(1), atol=0.051))
    k = f1.daily_bus_km.notna()
    check("File 1 energy_full_bev_mwh_day = daily_bus_km x 1.30 / 1000", np.allclose(f1.energy_full_bev_mwh_day[k], f1.daily_bus_km[k] * P["benchmark_kwh_km"] / 1000, rtol=1e-3))
    check("File 1 source_urls populated for every row", f1.source_urls.fillna("").str.len().gt(0).all())
if "File_4.csv" in F:
    f4 = F["File_4.csv"]
    check("File 4 has exactly 20 rows (2026-2035 x S0, S1)", len(f4) == 20 and set(zip(f4.year, f4.scenario)) == {(y, s) for y in range(2026, 2036) for s in (0, 1)})
    check("File 4: n_bev + n_h2 + n_cng = fleet_total (every row)", (f4.n_bev + f4.n_h2 + f4.n_cng == f4.fleet_total).all())
    check("File 4: ze_share_pct = 100 x (n_bev + n_h2) / fleet_total", np.allclose(f4.ze_share_pct, (100 * (f4.n_bev + f4.n_h2) / f4.fleet_total).round(1), atol=0.051))
    s1 = f4[(f4.scenario == 1) & (f4.year >= 2030)]
    check("File 4: S1 ze_share_pct = 100 from 2030 to 2035", (s1.ze_share_pct == 100).all())
    check("File 4: S1 n_cng = 0 from 2030 to 2035", (s1.n_cng == 0).all())
if "File_1.csv" in F:
    f1 = F["File_1.csv"]
    check("File 1 source_urls use '; ' as the separator (no '|')", not f1.source_urls.fillna("").str.contains(r"\|").any())
    check("File 1 reference_date is a valid YYYY-MM-DD date in every row",
          pd.to_datetime(f1.reference_date, format="%Y-%m-%d", errors="coerce").notna().all())
if "File_4.csv" in F:
    r26 = f4[(f4.scenario == 1) & (f4.year == 2026)].iloc[0]
    added = int(r26.n_bev + r26.n_h2) - (BASELINE_2025["n_bev"] + BASELINE_2025["n_h2"])
    check("File 4: S1 adds no more zero-emission buses in 2026 than are delivered (D3)", added <= S1_DELIVERED_2026,
          f"{added} added vs {S1_DELIVERED_2026} delivered")
print("\nBaseline 31 Dec 2025 used by Files 1 and 4:", BASELINE_2025 if "BASELINE_2025" in globals() else "NOT SET")
summary = pd.DataFrame(CHECKS)
display(summary)
print(f"\n{(summary.result == 'PASS').sum()} PASS / {(summary.result == 'FAIL').sum()} FAIL")
